clouds.title: The 10 basic Cloud Types
clouds.subtitle: High clouds: Cirrus (Ci), cirrocumulus (Cc), and cirrostratus (Cs) Mid-level clouds: Altocumulus (Ac), altostratus (As), and nimbostratus (Ns) Low-level clouds: Cumulus (Cu), stratocumulus (Sc), stratus (St), and cumulonimbus (Cb)
